title: Tips and Tricks for Better Pasting with Magic Page for Business Central

chapters.title: Creating multiple customers with default posting groups
Updating existing records by mapping keys
Pasting quantity updates in sales orders
Pasting shortcut dimensions in general journal

features.name: Magic Paste bulk customer creation
features.description: Paste customer data from external sources and map columns to customer fields including customer number, name, and posting groups. The system creates multiple new customers in a single paste operation.

features.name: Magic Paste key-based record updates
features.description: Map a key field to identify existing records and update multiple rows simultaneously with new values instead of creating duplicates. When a key is mapped, pasting updates the existing records rather than inserting new ones.
caveats: Requires key field to be mapped

features.name: Magic Paste selective column pasting
features.description: Paste only specific columns from copied data without needing to paste all columns. Users can select which column contains the data to update without breaking the operation.

features.name: Magic Paste multi-row update confirmation
features.description: When pasting into existing rows, the system prompts the user to choose between updating existing rows in order or inserting new rows. This prevents accidental data duplication.

features.name: Magic Paste hidden fields support
features.description: Access and paste into fields that are not visible on the screen by using a 'show hidden fields' option. Pasting into hidden fields is restricted to fields that can be brought in through personalization.
caveats: Only fields available through personalization can be used
Hidden fields must be valid for the record type

features.name: Magic Paste shortcut dimensions
features.description: Paste data into shortcut dimension fields in the general journal. The system automatically maps dimension data like department and customer group to their corresponding shortcut dimension codes.
